[[File:Kabam status effect HUD.png|left|300x300px]]
''Status effects are beneficial or harmful conditions that affect your bots in battle, often caused by a bot’s passive and active abilities and signature abilities. These effects can vary from permanent to temporary buffs or debuffs. For example, linked node buffs in the alliance mission feature provide permanent buffs. Some triggers in battle will spawn specific status effects.''

''You may view these effects as they appear under your bot’s or your opponent’s health bar, along with a cooldown meter indicating when the effects will wear off, if applicable.''

''The name of the status effect will also sometimes appear on or around the bots. These are the different kinds of effects that you may come across:''

| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
=== ICON ===
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
=== NAME ===

=== DESCRIPTION ===
|-

|-

|-

| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |A buff that ignores hit reactions, but still takes damage.
|}

| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Decreases the enemy's armor rating, increasing damage taken from attacks, and removes Armor Buff.
|-
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
==== Attack Debuff ====
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Decreases the enemy's attack rating, causing attacks to deal less damage.

| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Prevents any health recovery by the enemy.
|-

| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |

| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Removes enemy buffs.
|-

|-
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |

|-
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |

| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Freezes the enemy's power bar, preventing any new power from being acquired.
|-
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
==== Poison ====
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Deals direct damage over time.
|-
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
==== Backfire ====
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Deals damage if a special attack is used.
|-
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
==== Ranged Damage Debuff ====
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Decreases the enemy's attack rating for projectile attacks only.
|-
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
==== Shock ====
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |Applies energy (shock) damage over time. Often influences abilities that inflict Stun or Power Drain.
|-
| colspan="1" rowspan="1" |
